about: Ablations of the v1 pipeline on dev + dev_noisy (2,300 labelled rows) and the 9 hostile rows. Official grader numbers; paired differences against the reference with 95% conversation-bootstrap intervals (2,000 draws, harness.eval.paired). CPU ablations: LLM step off, reference results/raw/dev-pipeline-cpu. LLM ablations: recorded GPT-6 Luna answers replayed, reference results/raw/dev-pipeline-llm-replay. Script: experiments/ablations/run.py.

runs.changed: nothing: shipped pipeline, recorded Luna answers replayed at the shipped gate 0.642841; must reproduce dev-pipeline-llm-replay
runs.name: ref-llm

runs.changed: LLM step off (the CPU pipeline; must equal dev-pipeline-cpu)
runs.name: no-llm

runs.changed: LLM step on the 10% least-confident share: gate = 10% quantile of dev CPU confidence (0.433508) instead of the 20% one (0.642841)
runs.name: llm-10

runs.changed: LLM step on the 30% least-confident share: gate = 30% quantile of dev CPU confidence (0.795136) instead of the 20% one (0.642841)
runs.name: llm-30

runs.changed: gate keeps repeated sentences (the dedupe_text step removed)
runs.name: no-dedupe

runs.changed: no policy prior: action = argmax of the raw action probabilities (the stacker and the off-policy check are unchanged)
runs.name: no-prior

runs.changed: hard mask: only actions permitted by the flow model's argmax flow, instead of the soft expected permission
runs.name: hard-mask

runs.changed: no alias: literal published lists, so 'membership' is not permitted where only 'membership-privileges' is (prior and off-policy check both)
runs.name: no-alias

runs.changed: confidence = top action probability (after the prior) instead of the stacked correctness model; shipped thresholds kept
runs.name: conf-top-p

runs.changed: nothing: CPU model retrained by this folder's copy of the training code with the state block kept (retraining noise for ablation 6)
runs.name: state-copy

runs.changed: action model retrained on fold A without the dialogue-state block (text views only); stacker refit on fold B as in training
runs.name: no-state

runs.changed: gate cleans but its ROUTE flags are ignored (no routing, no cap, LLM not blocked); abstention for unreadable input kept
runs.name: gate-noroute

runs.changed: no gate at all: no cleaning, no flags, no routing by flags, no abstention (envelope check kept)
runs.name: gate-off

runs.changed: exploratory: gate on, but the no_dialogue flag does not route (the content flags injection, controls, bidi, surrogates, junk, no_known_text still do)
runs.name: gate-no-nodialogue

runs.changed: exploratory: no gate and off-policy routing off too (only the confidence thresholds route; close to v0 with the shipped thresholds)
runs.name: gate-off-nopol

llm_share_fold_b.about:
The dev gates for the 10% / 20% / 30% shares applied on train fold B (3,966 rows no model choice saw):
    out-of-fold CPU confidence, recorded Luna answers for fold B, paired against the LLM step off. Not graded by
    the official grader (fold B is train data); written to experiments/ablations/llm_share_fold_b.json.
